These results provide a microscopic lattice foundation for timelike entanglement and for Lorentzian twist-operator methods beyond equal-time regions.
summary: 我们使用时空密度矩阵研究量子场论中的类时纠缠，并提供微观晶格实现。对于二维自由实标量场，我们将高斯对角化方法扩展到一般非厄米约简时空密度矩阵，并确定其在一般正则情况下的完整非零谱以及所有整数 Rényi 矩。实时复制结构使用洛伦兹分支点扭曲算子相关函数来识别这些时刻。我们针对圆上的完整四点函数、具有狄利克雷和诺伊曼边界条件的边界两点函数以及大规模形状因子预测来测试这种识别，发现不同因果机制中幅度和相位的定量一致性。边界设置展示了一个有限因果连接窗口，其中每个整数 Rényi 熵都是实数，这表明现实并不等于因果断开。这些结果为类时纠缠和等时区域之外的洛伦兹扭曲算子方法提供了微观晶格基础。

title: Landau-Ginzburg description of an exceptional ${\mathcal N}=1$ minimal model
abstract: The $\mathcal N=1$ superconformal minimal model with $m=12$ and the exceptional modular invariant $(E_6,D_8)$ is the unitary minimal model of the super-$W_3$ algebra. We propose its Landau-Ginzburg description using two real scalar superfields with the cubic superpotential ${\cal W}=g_1 XY^2/2 + g_2X^3/6$. For $g_1=g_2$, this superpotential is known to describe a product of two $m=3$ $\mathcal N=1$ superconformal minimal models, which is the $m=10$ model with the $(D_6,E_6)$ modular invariant. The exceptional $m=12$ superconformal minimal model is realized at a different fixed point of the same theory. Testing this Landau-Ginzburg description requires the fusion ring of the minimal model, which we obtain from the modular data of the extended algebra. The fusion ring has a $\mathbb Z_2$ grading by chiral fermion parity that the ordinary fusion coefficients do not determine. This grading, composed with conjugation, gives the generator of the R-parity $\mathbb Z_2^{R}$ of the Landau-Ginzburg theory. We then treat the theory with superpotential $\cal W$ as a Gross-Neveu-Yukawa model in $d=4-\epsilon$ and find a weakly coupled infrared fixed point with $g_1/g_2=3/2+\mathcal O(\epsilon)$, at which supersymmetry emerges. We also describe the renormalization group flow from this fixed point to the decoupled fixed point with $g_1=g_2$. The operator dimensions at the coupled fixed point, continued to $d=2$, agree approximately with their values in the $m=12$ superconformal minimal model. Finally, we estimate the scaling dimensions in the new interacting $d=3$ $\mathcal N=1$ superconformal field theory.
summary:
$\mathcal N=1$ 超共形最小模型，$m=12$ 和异常模不变量 $(E_6,D_8)$ 是超 $W_3$ 代数的酉最小模型。我们使用两个具有立方超势 ${\cal W}=g_1 XY^2/2 + g_2X^3/6$ 的实标量超场提出其 Landau-Ginzburg 描述。对于 $g_1=g_2$，已知该超势描述了两个 $m=3$ $\mathcal N=1$ 超共形最小模型的乘积，即具有 $(D_6,E_6)$ 模不变量的 $m=10$ 模型。特殊的 $m=12$ 超共形最小模型是在同一理论的不同固定点实现的。测试此 Landau-Ginzburg 描述需要最小模型的融合环，这是我们从扩展代数的模数据中获得的。融合环具有由普通融合系数无法确定的手性费米子宇称的 $\mathbb Z_2$ 分级。这种分级与共轭相结合，给出了 Landau-Ginzburg 理论的 R 宇称 $\mathbb Z_2^{R}$ 的生成器。

然后，我们将具有超势 $\cal W$ 的理论视为 $d=4-\epsilon$ 中的 Gross-Neveu-Yukawa 模型，并找到 $g_1/g_2=3/2+\mathcal O(\epsilon)$ 的弱耦合红外固定点，在该点出现超对称性。我们还用 $g_1=g_2$ 描述从该固定点到解耦固定点的重整化群流。耦合固定点处的算子尺寸继续到 $d=2$，与 $m=12$ 超共形最小模型中的值大致一致。最后，我们估计新的相互作用 $d=3$ $\mathcal N=1$ 超共形场论中的尺度维数。

title: Detecting one-dimensional bosonic SPT phases via twisted entropic order parameter
abstract: Entanglement asymmetry, introduced by F. Ares, S. Murciano and P. Calabrese, provides a density-matrix diagnostic of symmetry breaking and successfully captures the Landau data associated with a broken symmetry pattern. However, it is by now well established that gapped quantum many-body systems can exhibit phases which are not characterized solely by Landau symmetry breaking. A fundamental example is a symmetry-protected topological (SPT) phase, and the ordinary definition of entanglement asymmetry is insensitive to this topological information. In this work we introduce a refined quantity, which we call the twisted entropic order parameter, designed to detect SPT phases from reduced density matrices, particularly focusing on one-dimensional bosonic systems. The key ingredient in our construction is an ancilla degrees of freedom that coherently records the untwisted state and the twisted state associated to a one-ended topological defect of unbroken symmetry, so that the enlarged density matrix retains the charge carried by the defect endpoint. We demonstrate our proposal in concrete lattice models and further generalize it beyond ordinary group symmetries, establishing its ability to diagnose SPT phases. This provides a first step toward a unified entanglement-asymmetry framework for diagnosing quantum phases of matter.
summary:
由 F. Ares、S. Murciano 和 P. Calabrese 提出的纠缠不对称性提供了对称性破缺的密度矩阵诊断，并成功捕获了与破缺对称性模式相关的朗道数据。然而，目前已经明确的是，有隙量子多体系统可以表现出不仅仅以朗道对称破缺为特征的相位。一个基本的例子是对称保护拓扑（SPT）相，而纠缠不对称的普通定义对此拓扑信息不敏感。在这项工作中，我们引入了一个精炼量，我们称之为扭曲熵序参数，旨在从约简密度矩阵中检测 SPT 相位，特别关注一维玻色子系统。我们构造中的关键要素是辅助自由度，它连贯地记录与未破坏对称的单端拓扑缺陷相关的未扭曲状态和扭曲状态，以便扩大的密度矩阵保留缺陷端点携带的电荷。

我们在具体晶格模型中展示了我们的建议，并进一步将其推广到普通群对称性之外，建立了其诊断 SPT 阶段的能力。这为诊断物质的量子相提供了统一的纠缠不对称框架的第一步。

title: Graviton vertex operators in the de Donder gauge and BRST descent
abstract: We revisit the role of the trace sector of the graviton in covariant string amplitudes by constructing the ghost-number-three graviton vertex operator via BRST descent, imposing only the de Donder gauge condition without requiring tracelessness. The resulting operator is well defined even at zero momentum, while for nonzero momentum the trace-dependent sector of the descent chain forms a trivial BRST descent chain. Evaluating its disk one-point function in the presence of a D$p$-brane, we show that the trace-dependent term is essential for reproducing the correct graviton-brane coupling, canceling the Dirichlet-direction contributions and leaving the expected coupling to the world-volume components.
summary: 我们通过 BRST 下降构造鬼三号引力子顶点算子，重新审视引力子迹扇区在协变弦振幅中的作用，仅施加 de Donder 规范条件而不需要无迹性。即使在零动量下，所得算子也得到了很好的定义，而对于非零动量，下降链的迹相关部分形成了一个平凡的 BRST 下降链。在存在 D$p$ 膜的情况下评估其圆盘单点函数，我们表明，迹相关项对于再现正确的引力子膜耦合、消除狄利克雷方向贡献并将预期耦合留给世界体积分量至关重要。

title: Massless contraction of massive particles in the infinite boost limit
abstract: Massless particles, defined through Wigner's induced representations of the Poincaré group, are obtained as a limit of infinitely boosted massive particles wherein the massive little group undergoes an Inönü--Wigner contraction to the massless one. It is demonstrated that the spin-$s$ multiplet of a massive representation re-organizes into the direct sum of massless particles with helicities in the range $[-s,s]$. This group theoretic result is the Hilbert space counterpart of the Stückelberg formulation of massive fields of spin $s$ in the high-energy limit, where the Stückelberg fields become independent massless fields of spins $s'\leq s$ in integer steps. It therefore also provides the kinematic setting of the Goldstone equivalence theorem.
summary: 无质量粒子，通过维格纳对庞加莱群的诱导表示来定义，是作为无限增强的大质量粒子的极限而获得的，其中大质量的小群经历了伊诺努-维格纳收缩到无质量粒子。证明了质量表示的自旋$s$多重态重新组织成螺旋度在$[-s,s]$范围内的无质量粒子的直接和。该群理论结果是高能极限下大质量自旋场 $s$ 的 Stückelberg 公式的希尔伯特空间对应，其中 Stückelberg 场以整数步长变成独立的无质量自旋场 $s'\leq s$。因此，它还提供了戈德斯通等效定理的运动学设置。

title: Gauss Law, Monodromy Defect, Magnetic Lattice Translation, and Lattice Duality
abstract: In a Hamiltonian lattice gauge theory, the physical Hilbert space is fixed by the Gauss law, by choosing an eigenspace of the Gauss law operator which generates the gauge transformation. Choosing a non-trivial eigenspace is referred to as the modified Gauss law. In 2+1d dynamical U(1) pure gauge theory, we show that these physical Hilbert spaces are defect Hilbert spaces associated with non-topological monodromy defects for monopole operators and topological defects for U(1) 1-form symmetry, inserted along the time direction. We also construct the corresponding lattice translation operators. Under a nontrivially modified Gauss law, these translations obey a magnetic translation algebra. Finally, we discuss how the modified Gauss laws are manifested in 2+1d compact bosons, via exact duality on the lattice.
summary: 在哈密顿格规范理论中，通过选择生成规范变换的高斯定律算子的特征空间，物理希尔伯特空间由高斯定律固定。选择非平凡的特征空间称为修正高斯定律。在 2+1d 动力学 U(1) 纯规范理论中，我们证明这些物理希尔伯特空间是与单极子算子的非拓扑单性缺陷和 U(1) 1-形式对称性的拓扑缺陷相关的缺陷希尔伯特空间，沿时间方向插入。我们还构造了相应的格平移算子。根据非平凡修改的高斯定律，这些平移遵循磁平移代数。最后，我们讨论如何通过晶格上的精确对偶性在 2+1d 紧致玻色子中体现修改后的高斯定律。

title: The Casimir effect in Gribov-Zwanziger theory
abstract: We consider Yang-Mills theory with two infinite parallel plates, separated by a distance \(L\), that are perfect magnetic conductors (PMC) or perfect electric conductors (PEC). Recently, it was shown that the Gribov copy problem persists in such a setting. We then study the Gribov-Zwanziger (GZ) action in the presence of those boundaries using functional integral methods. Lagrange multiplier fields allow one to lift the boundary conditions into the action, after which the boundary modifications to the gluon propagator can straightforwardly be determined. In the PEC case, we provide evidence that, even when translation invariance is (partially) broken, the usual horizon term in the GZ action still restricts the functional integral to the Gribov region. We compute the Casimir energy for GZ with PMC or PEC plates, both directly from the functional integral and from the energy-momentum tensor, obtaining consistent results. We compare our analytical results with recent lattice data, in both 4D and 3D. A priori, one might expect that the boundary-modified gluon propagator introduces new \(L\)-dependencies into the GZ gap equation. This would make the Gribov mass \(\gamma\) dynamically dependent on \(L\), implying an interesting interplay with the Casimir energy. However, we show that no such dynamical \(L\)-dependence occurs within the current approximation.
summary:
我们考虑杨-米尔斯理论，其中有两个无限平行板，间隔距离 \(L\)，它们是完美磁导体 (PMC) 或完美电导体 (PEC)。最近，研究表明 Gribov 复制问题在这种设置中仍然存在。然后，我们使用函数积分方法研究存在这些边界的 Gribov-Zwanziger (GZ) 作用。拉格朗日乘子场允许人们将边界条件提升到动作中，然后可以直接确定对胶子传播器的边界修改。在 PEC 案例中，我们提供的证据表明，即使平移不变性（部分）被打破，GZ 动作中的通常水平项仍然限制 Gribov 区域的函数积分。我们使用 PMC 或 PEC 板直接从函数积分和能量动量张量计算 GZ 的卡西米尔能量，获得一致的结果。我们将我们的分析结果与最新的 4D 和 3D 晶格数据进行比较。先验地，人们可能期望边界修改的胶子传播器将新的 \(L\) 依赖性引入到 GZ 间隙方程中。

这将使格里波夫质量 \(\gamma\) 动态依赖于 \(L\)，这意味着与卡西米尔能量的有趣相互作用。然而，我们表明在当前近似值内不存在这种动态\(L\)依赖性。

title: Effective Dynamics of Inflationary End-of-the-World Branes in AdS$_3$
abstract: We develop an effective description of a two-dimensional cosmological end-of-the-world brane embedded in AdS$_3$, with a scalar field localized on the brane. Integrating out bulk degrees of freedom, especially in the small-gradient regime, the effective action reduces to a Liouville-like theory coupled to the brane scalar. We then construct brane trajectories whose induced geometry realizes slow-roll inflation and reconstruct the associated scalar profile and potential. We also study regular Euclidean brane geometries that admit a smooth continuation to Lorentzian de Sitter and inflationary universes, and evaluate the semiclassical on-shell action for the de Sitter solution. Finally, we analyze linearized inhomogeneous perturbations and find no exponentially growing mode within the regime of validity of the approximation.
summary: 我们对嵌入 AdS$_3$ 中的二维宇宙学世界末日膜进行了有效描述，并在膜上定位了标量场。整合大量自由度，特别是在小梯度状态下，有效作用可简化为与膜标量耦合的类刘维尔理论。然后，我们构建膜轨迹，其诱导的几何形状实现慢滚动膨胀并重建相关的标量轮廓和势。我们还研究了常规欧几里得膜几何结构，该几何结构允许洛伦兹德西特宇宙和暴胀宇宙的平滑延续，并评估德西特解的半经典壳上作用。最后，我们分析了线性化非均匀扰动，发现在近似有效性范围内没有指数增长模式。

title: Fermion quantum field theory on curved and non-inertial backgrounds in standard-Minkowski form
abstract: Quantum field theory on curved and non-inertial backgrounds contains background- and foliation-dependent quantities in the canonical Lagrangian, the hypersurface inner product and bilinear form, as well as in the equal-time anti-commutation relations. In this work, we determine a local fermion-field redefinition that brings these canonical structures into their standard-Minkowski forms, i. e., the forms they assume in Cartesian inertial coordinates on Minkowski spacetime, where the zeroth world coordinate is identified as the coordinate of time. Starting from the generally covariant Dirac action minimally coupled to a spin-1 gauge field, we derive the corresponding Lagrangian, fermionic inner product, and quantization rule in an Arnowitt-Deser-Misner decomposition, formulated in arbitrary world coordinates. We identify the generalized temporal gamma matrix as the common geometric factor governing the canonical temporal structure of all three quantities. Using a field redefinition, we transform this generalized temporal gamma matrix to its standard-Minkowski form, thereby mapping the fermionic inner product and the equal-time anti-commutation relation to their standard-Minkowski expressions, while transferring the explicit background and foliation dependence to the transformed Lagrangian and fermion-field operators. We show that such a field redefinition necessarily consists of a local rescaling and a fixing of the local Lorentz frame. This procedure restores the conventional canonical normalization from standard-Minkowski spacetime used for fermionic mode quantization and occupation-number operators. The transformed Lagrangian consequently assumes a generalized first-order Schrödinger form, leading to the familiar rest-energy term and spacetime-magnetic couplings, as well as to the leading non-relativistic limit, in which temporal derivatives are separated from spatial ones.
summary:
弯曲和非惯性背景的量子场论包含规范拉格朗日、超曲面内积和双线性形式以及等时反交换关系中的背景和叶状相关量。在这项工作中，我们确定了局部费米子场重新定义，将这些规范结构带入其标准闵可夫斯基形式，即。即，它们在闵可夫斯基时空中的笛卡尔惯性坐标中呈现的形式，其中第零个世界坐标被确定为时间坐标。从与自旋 1 规范场最小耦合的一般协变狄拉克作用开始，我们在 Arnowitt-Deser-Misner 分解中推导出相应的拉格朗日、费米子内积和量化规则，并以任意世界坐标表示。我们将广义时间伽玛矩阵确定为控制所有三个量的规范时间结构的公共几何因子。

使用场重新定义，我们将这个广义时间伽玛矩阵转换为其标准Minkowski形式，从而将费米子内积和等时间反交换关系映射到它们的标准Minkowski表达式，同时将显式背景和叶状依赖性转移到转换后的拉格朗日和费米子场算子。我们表明，这种场重新定义必然包括局部重新缩放和局部洛伦兹框架的固定。该过程从用于费米子模式量化和占用数算子的标准闵可夫斯基时空恢复传统的规范归一化。因此，变换后的拉格朗日量呈现广义一阶薛定谔形式，导致熟悉的静止能量项和时空磁耦合，以及主要的非相对论极限，其中时间导数与空间导数分离。

title: Logarithmic supertranslations as asymptotic symmetries of gravity at null infinity
abstract: Logarithmic supertranslations have been shown recently to be symmetries of the gravitational field at spatial infinity. We extend this work by proving explicitly that they are also symmetries at null infinity. We also show that the logarithmic supertranslation charges match at the ``corner" where spatial infinity and null infinity meet. This fully establishes that the asymptotic symmetry group of gravity in the asymptotically flat context contains the logarithmic supertranslations.
summary: 最近，对数超平移被证明是空间无限处引力场的对称性。我们通过明确证明它们也是零无穷大处的对称性来扩展这项工作。我们还表明，对数超平移电荷在空间无穷大和零无穷大相交的“角”处匹配。这充分证明了渐近平坦背景下的引力渐近对称群包含对数超平移。

title: Optimizing the dilaton potential in holographic QCD via phase-transition constraints
abstract: In bottom-up holographic QCD (HQCD), two primary approaches are commonly employed: the potential reconstruction method, where the background geometry is fixed a priori and the dilaton potential is derived, and the direct method, where the potential is specified explicitly. While the reconstruction method is highly effective for capturing the phenomenological properties of QCD under extreme conditions, a subtlety arises in that the reconstructed potential depends on the chosen holographic boundary conditions. To address this issue, we propose constructing a dilaton potential designed to reproduce the typical features of HQCD phase transitions obtained by the reconstruction method, rather than one derived solely from HQCD vacuum solution. Using a light-quark model as an example, we construct a potential that captures the principal features of the phase structure of this model. Its parameters are determined at zero chemical potential by minimizing the deviation between the temperature dependence on the horizon position in the direct and reconstructed models and by fitting to the same position of a critical endpoint (CEP). The resulting minimal-potential model satisfactorily recovers the physics of the light-quark model even at relatively small chemical potential. Specifically, it yields a first-order phase transition (FOPT) line close to those obtained from the reconstruction method. Additionally, the minimal-potential model reproduces a rising Cornell-like quark-antiquark potential up to the hadronic distance $\ell=1.5$ fm, which we use as a phenomenological finite-distance criterion for confinement. The location of the confinement/deconfinement crossover in this minimal-potential model is also close to its counterpart in the original light-quark model.
summary:
在自下而上的全息 QCD (HQCD) 中，通常采用两种主要方法：势重建方法，其中背景几何形状先验固定并导出膨胀势，以及直接方法，其中显式指定势。虽然重建方法对于捕获极端条件下 QCD 的现象学特性非常有效，但出现了一个微妙之处，即重建势取决于所选的全息边界条件。为了解决这个问题，我们建议构建一个膨胀势，旨在重现通过重建方法获得的 HQCD 相变的典型特征，而不是仅仅从 HQCD 真空解中导出。以光夸克模型为例，我们构建了一个捕获该模型相结构主要特征的势。其参数是在零化学势下确定的，通过最小化直接模型和重建模型中温度对地平线位置的依赖性之间的偏差，并通过拟合关键端点（CEP）的相同位置。

由此产生的最小势模型即使在相对较小的化学势下也令人满意地恢复了光夸克模型的物理性质。具体来说，它产生的一阶相变 (FOPT) 线接近通过重构​​方法获得的线。此外，最小势模型再现了不断上升的类康奈尔夸克-反夸克势，直至强子距离 $\ell=1.5$ fm，我们将其用作限制的现象学有限距离准则。这个最小势模型中的禁闭/解禁交叉的位置也接近于原始光夸克模型中的对应位置。

title: Chiral Spin(7) Sigma Models and Topological Modular Forms
abstract: We construct canonical chiral $\mathcal N=(0,1)$ sigma models on Spin(7) manifolds. The Spin(7) structure fixes the rank-seven bundle of the left-moving fermions, whose quadratic index matches the tangent representation, so the internal anomalies cancel while the rank difference leaves the gravitational anomaly of one right-moving Majorana--Weyl fermion. A transverse section of the left-moving bundle has a 1D zero locus with induced String structure, and we compute its class in the first torsion group of topological modular forms. The class is nonzero precisely when the Euler characteristic of the target is odd. The standard Joyce action on the torus has no internal finite-group anomaly and can be gauged to define an exact chiral spin QFT. We show that the orbifold Euler characteristic is even throughout the diagonal Joyce family generated by coordinate reflections and half-shifts preserving the Cayley form. By contrast, a free antiholomorphic quotient of the Fermat sextic is a compact torsion-free Spin(7) target with Euler characteristic 1305 and realizes the nonzero class.
summary: 我们在 Spin(7) 流形上构建规范的手性 $\mathcal N=(0,1)$ sigma 模型。 Spin(7)结构固定了左移费米子的七阶束，其二次指数与正切表示相匹配，因此内部异常消失，而阶差留下了一个右移马约拉纳-韦尔费米子的引力异常。左动束的横截面具有诱导弦结构的一维零轨迹，我们在拓扑模形式的第一挠群中计算其类别。当目标的欧拉特征为奇数时，类恰好非零。环面上的标准乔伊斯作用没有内部有限群异常，并且可以通过测量来定义精确的手性自旋 QFT。我们证明，环折欧拉特征甚至遍及由坐标反射和半位移生成的对角乔伊斯族，保留了凯莱形式。相比之下，费马六次方的自由反全纯商是具有欧拉特性1305的紧致无扭Spin(7)目标，并实现非零类。

title: Non-invertible Selection Rules from Generalized Discrete Gauging of Finite Non-Abelian Symmetries
abstract: We investigate non-invertible selection rules originating from the discrete $H$-gauging of theories with an underlying discrete global symmetry group $G$. To systematically describe these theories, we formulate a general framework for $H$-gauged models that incorporates generalized field transformations. Our approach naturally accommodates non-Abelian groups, for which multidimensional irreducible representations play an essential role. In such models with non-Abelian groups, the transformations induced by $H$ non-trivially mix the internal components of $G$-multiplets, potentially projecting out specific degrees of freedom. Consequently, conventional selection rules based on standard tensor product decompositions or conjugacy classes become insufficient. By analyzing the full semidirect product $G \rtimes H$, we introduce projected characters to derive necessary and sufficient conditions for non-vanishing $n$-point bare couplings. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the remaining field components obey an associative fusion-like algebra governed by their Clebsch-Gordan coefficients. Phenomenologically, these selection rules restrict allowed interactions and impose specific relations among coupling constants. We illustrate our results through concrete examples, including $\Delta(54) \cong \Delta(27)\rtimes \mathbb{Z}_2$ and $S_4 \cong A_4 \rtimes \mathbb{Z}_2$.
summary:
我们研究源自离散 $H$ 理论计量的不可逆选择规则，其基础是离散全局对称群 $G$。为了系统地描述这些理论，我们为 $H$ 计量模型制定了一个通用框架，其中包含广义场变换。我们的方法自然地适应非阿贝尔群，其中多维不可约表示起着至关重要的作用。在此类具有非阿贝尔群的模型中，$H$ 引起的变换非平凡地混合了 $G$ 重数的内部组件，可能会投射出特定的自由度。因此，基于标准张量积分解或共轭类的传统选择规则变得不够。通过分析全半直积$G \rtimes H$，我们引入投影特征来推导非零$n$点裸耦合的充分必要条件。此外，我们证明了其余的场分量服从由其 Clebsch-Gordan 系数控制的类联想融合代数。

从现象学上讲，这些选择规则限制了允许的相互作用，并在耦合常数之间强加了特定的关系。我们通过具体的例子来说明我们的结果，包括 $\Delta(54) \cong \Delta(27)\rtimes \mathbb{Z}_2$ 和 $S_4 \cong A_4 \rtimes \mathbb{Z}_2$。

title: Henstock--Kurzweil Gauge Integral in the Non--Gaussian Regime: A Machine--Verified Construction
abstract: We develop a machine-checked construction of non-Gaussian functional integrals using the Henstock--Kurzweil gauge integral and Chernoff product approximations. The central object is a finite family of bosonic modes with action S(phi) = (1/2) phi^T A phi + lambda * sum_i phi_i^4, where A is positive definite. We prove that the one-mode integral I(omega, j, lambda) is finite, strictly positive, monotone and infinitely differentiable in the coupling lambda on [0, infinity). Its derivatives are given by convergent integrals of phi^{4k} with the same weight, not by the divergent perturbative series. The M-mode influence functional factorises into one-mode integrals and is bounded by its Gaussian value. A Chernoff / Lie--Trotter splitting handles the non-commutativity of the free and non-Gaussian generators. All statements are formalised in Lean 4 with Mathlib; the accompanying file this http URL is free of sorry and uses only the standard axioms propext, this http URL , this http URL . Four illustrative applications are worked out at the level of explicit formulas: the Duffing oscillator, local volatility (CEV) in finance, Wilson--Cowan neural fields, and non-Gaussian quantum reservoirs. The construction is completely direct and does not use Wick rotation, Wiener measure, zeta-regularisation or analytic continuation back from imaginary time.
summary:
我们使用 Henstock--Kurzweil 规范积分和 Chernoff 乘积近似开发了一种经过机器检验的非高斯函数积分结构。中心对象是有限族玻色子模式，其作用为 S(phi) = (1/2) phi^T A phi + lambda * sum_i phi_i^4，其中 A 是正定的。我们证明单模积分 I(omega, j, lambda) 在 [0, 无穷大) 上的耦合 lambda 中是有限的、严格正的、单调且无限可微的。它的导数由具有相同权重的 phi^{4k} 的收敛积分给出，而不是由发散微扰级数给出。 M 模影响函数分解为单模积分，并受其高斯值限制。 Chernoff / Lie--Trotter 分裂处理自由和非高斯生成元的非交换性。所有语句均在 Lean 4 中通过 Mathlib 进行形式化；附带的文件 this http URL 是免费的，并且仅使用标准公理 propext， this http URL ， this http URL 。

在显式公式的层面上提出了四个说明性应用：杜芬振荡器、金融中的局域波动性（CEV）、威尔逊-考恩神经场和非高斯量子储层。该构造是完全直接的，不使用威克旋转、维纳测度、zeta 正则化或从虚时间回溯的分析延拓。

title: A Time-Frequency Framework for GKP Codes
abstract: We develop a time--frequency framework for lattice GKP codes in which ideal codewords are realized in the modulation space $M^\infty$ and identified, through a vector-valued Zak transform, with a finite logical fibre over the continuous syndrome torus. Multi-window Gabor analysis then represents the logical vector by a finite block of adjoint-lattice coefficients. We prove that the normalized block map is an isometry, obtain an explicit recovering projection, and derive stable logical reconstruction. We further construct normalizable GKP approximants as lattice-envelope Gabor multipliers and establish weak-$*$ convergence and asymptotically isometric encoding. Finally, we recover displacement syndromes from phase relations between translated coefficient blocks and quantify their stability under additive perturbations.
summary: 我们开发了一个用于点阵 GKP 码的时频框架，其中理想的码字在调制空间 $M^\infty$ 中实现，并通过向量值 Zak 变换识别出连续校正子环上的有限逻辑纤维。然后，多窗口 Gabor 分析通过有限的伴随格系数块来表示逻辑向量。我们证明了归一化块图是等距的，获得了显式的恢复投影，并导出了稳定的逻辑重建。我们进一步将可归一化的 GKP 近似构造为格子包络 Gabor 乘子，并建立弱 $*$ 收敛和渐近等距编码。最后，我们从转换系数块之间的相位关系中恢复位移综合症，并量化它们在加性扰动下的稳定性。

title: Probabilistic representation and limit theorems for particle numbers of quasi-free states
abstract: We study the particle number distribution of locally interacting bosonic quasi- free states, which arise in various areas of mathematical physics. We show that the particle number decomposes into an infinite sum of independent geometrically distributed random variables, confirming predictions from the physics literature. This representation yields exponential tail bounds for the particle number, a law of small numbers together with a large deviation principle at logarithmic speed when the lattice spacing diverges, and a central limit theorem when it vanishes. As an application, we obtain a detailed description of the statistics of the quantum depletion in Bose--Einstein condensates, with the constants explicit in terms of the scattering length of the interaction potential.
summary: 我们研究数学物理各个领域中出现的局部相互作用的玻色准自由态的粒子数分布。我们证明粒子数分解为独立几何分布随机变量的无限和，证实了物理学文献的预测。这种表示产生了粒子数的指数尾界、小数定律以及当晶格间距发散时在对数速度下的大偏差原理，以及当它消失时的中心极限定理。作为一个应用，我们获得了玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中量子耗尽统计的详细描述，其中常数以相互作用势的散射长度明确表示。

title: Why we should condition denoising diffusion generative models on windows of past observations
abstract: Data assimilation (DA) is, traditionally, a cycling process that relies on time-dependent priors to propagate information from past observations to future cycles. Using denoising diffusion generative modeling for DA is challenging because standard approaches use a fixed training data set, which in turn leads to a static prior that ignores information from past observations. Because past observations are ignored, DA systems with static priors lead to larger posterior errors than cycling DA systems. Incorporating time-dependent priors into generative models, however, requires expensive and frequent retraining. Motivated by linear systems theory - where the dependence of a prediction of a Kalman filter on past observations decays exponentially - we condition diffusion models on short windows of past observations. Specifically, we describe training procedures for two frameworks: a diffusion DA system predicting the current state given a set of past observations, and a diffusion ``direct observation prediction'' (DOP) system, predicting future observations given a set of past observations. Using a canonical linear system, we show that both systems can achieve the minimal posterior error characteristic of a fully-cycled DA/DOP system, without re-training, provided the time windows are long enough. The linear setup ensures analytical tractability, avoids confounding neural network training errors, and confirms that conditioning on windows of past observations is required for efficient and accurate diffusion-based DA or DOP.
summary:
传统上，数据同化（DA）是一个循环过程，依赖于时间相关的先验将信息从过去的观察传播到未来的循环。使用去噪扩散生成模型进行 DA 具有挑战性，因为标准方法使用固定的训练数据集，这反过来又导致静态先验忽略了过去观察的信息。由于过去的观察被忽略，具有静态先验的 DA 系统会导致比循环 DA 系统更大的后验误差。然而，将时间相关的先验纳入生成模型需要昂贵且频繁的再训练。受线性系统理论的启发（卡尔曼滤波器的预测对过去观测的依赖性呈指数衰减），我们根据过去观测的短窗口来调节扩散模型。具体来说，我们描述了两个框架的训练程序：一个扩散 DA 系统，根据一组过去的观察结果预测当前状态；以及一个扩散“直接观察预测”（DOP）系统，根据一组过去的观察结果预测未来的观察结果。

使用规范线性系统，我们表明，只要时间窗口足够长，两个系统都可以实现全循环 DA/DOP 系统的最小后验误差特性，而无需重新训练。线性设置确保了分析的易处理性，避免了混淆的神经网络训练错误，并确认了高效且准确的基于扩散的 DA 或 DOP 需要对过去观察的窗口进行调节。

title: The kinematic structures and the inertial geometry of a moving charge
abstract: We ask how much of the geometry a charged particle moves in is fixed by its motion, and how much a particle must bring. We ask of a symplectic structure only that it relate velocity to momentum as Hamilton's equations do, and we ask it of every energy at once. In particular, we show that the structures meeting that demand are the canonical one and its twists by a closed two-form of the base. A field provides the two-form, a particle the multiplier before it, which we identify constitutively with its charge. Thus, a single energy governs a family of structures, and each particle takes the one its charge fixes. We then ask what a particle must bring to be given a momentum, and we show that the degree of that map settles the degree at which a field enters Newton's Second Law. An antisymmetric bilinear form returns no Lorentz force, whilst a Randers metric returns one --- a length whose difference from a Riemannian one is linear in the velocity. Moreover, we find that metric already within the twisted structure, as its primitive over a level of the free energy, and its law of transport to be nonlinear, no affine connection being known to serve. Under an indefinite signature the length parts from the dynamics, and the extremals turn from shortest to longest. On the round sphere a monopole flux leaves no such metric, whilst the transport remains and prequantisation, given a unit of action, restricts the charge to a lattice. In this manner, we conclude that each charge-to-mass ratio receives a geometry of its own, so that by a functionalist criterion none of them is the spacetime of a charged particle.
summary:
我们问带电粒子移动的几何形状有多少是由其运动决定的，以及粒子必须带来多少。我们只要求辛结构像汉密尔顿方程那样将速度与动量联系起来，并且我们同时要求每个能量。特别是，我们表明满足该要求的结构是规范结构及其由封闭的两种形式的基础的扭曲。场提供了两种形式，粒子提供了它之前的乘数，我们用它的电荷来本构地识别它。因此，单一能量控制着一系列结构，每个粒子都采用其电荷固定的能量。然后我们问一个粒子必须带来什么才能获得动量，我们证明该映射的阶数决定了场进入牛顿第二定律的程度。反对称双线性形式不返回洛伦兹力，而兰德斯度量则返回洛伦兹力——其与黎曼力的差异与速度呈线性关系的长度。此外，我们发现该度量已经在扭曲结构中，作为其在自由能水平上的原语，并且其传输定律是非线性的，没有已知的仿射连接起作用。

在不定签名下，长度从动力学中分离出来，极值从最短变为最长。在圆形球体上，单极子通量没有留下这样的度量，而传输仍然存在，并且预量化（给定一个作用单位）将电荷限制在晶格内。通过这种方式，我们得出结论，每个荷质比都有自己的几何形状，因此根据功能主义标准，它们都不是带电粒子的时空。

title: Recent Advances on a Model for the Electromagnetic Dirac Field at Thermal Equilibrium
abstract: We review recent progress on a model for the relativistic electron-positron field interacting with a classical electromagnetic field at positive temperature. The ultimate goal is to advance our comprehension of how thermal backgrounds affect polarisation mechanisms of this quantum system.
summary: 我们回顾了相对论性电子-正电子场在正温度下与经典电磁场相互作用的模型的最新进展。最终目标是加深我们对热背景如何影响该量子系统偏振机制的理解。

title: A proof of the Hodge universality conjecture at nonzero dispersion
abstract: We prove that a scalar tau-symmetric Hamiltonian deformation of the Riemann hierarchy in generalized standard form is uniquely determined by the nonzero coefficient of $u_x^2$ and the coefficients of $u_{xx}^g$, $g\ge2$, in its first Hamiltonian density. This determines the original hierarchy up to normal Miura transformations. Combined with the construction of Hodge-class double ramification hierarchies by Buryak--Rossi, this establishes Hodge universality at nonzero dispersion.
summary: 我们证明，广义标准形式的黎曼层次结构的标量 tau 对称哈密顿变形是由 $u_x^2$ 的非零系数和 $u_{xx}^g$、$g\ge2$ 的系数在其第一哈密顿密度中唯一确定的。这决定了正常 Miura 变换的原始层次结构。结合Buryak-Rossi构建的Hodge级双分支层次结构，建立了非零色散的Hodge普适性。

title: On asymptotic expansions of the density of states for Poisson distributed random Schrödinger operators
abstract: We study a random Schrödinger operator with a potential distributed according to a Poisson process. Asymptotic expansions for traces of resolvents in the limit of small disorder are derived. Explicit estimates for the expansion coefficients are given and we show that their infinite volume limits are finite as the spectral parameter approaches the spectrum of the free Laplacian. As an application we derive bounds on the integrated density of states.
summary: 我们研究了一个随机薛定谔算子，其势能根据泊松过程分布。导出了在小无序极限下求解迹的渐近展开式。给出了展开系数的显式估计，并且我们表明，当谱参数接近自由拉普拉斯谱时，它们的无限体积限制是有限的。作为一个应用，我们得出了积分态密度的界限。

title: A closed signature formula for the Katz-Long-Moody Hermitian form
abstract: The Katz-Long-Moody construction associates to a representation of the semidirect product of a free group and a braid group, defined by the Artin action, and a nonzero parameter a new representation of the same group. On the pure braid group it corresponds to Haraoka's multiplicative middle convolution for KZ-type equations. For unitary input and a convolution parameter on the unit circle other than one, the construction equips the quotient representation with a canonical non-degenerate invariant Hermitian form. We give a closed formula for its signature in terms of the eigenangles of the input local monodromies, the eigenangles of their ordered product, and the convolution parameter. The formula accounts for the kernel of the form before passage to the quotient and for signature changes at resonant parameters. It determines precisely when the induced form is definite, answering the definiteness problem posed in the companion paper. Definiteness implies unitarizability of the output representation; the converse holds when that representation is irreducible. The proof uses elementary linear algebra: a determinant identity, explicit block-pivot formulas, and an inertia formula for sums of Cayley transforms of unitary matrices. As applications, we compare the rank-one construction explicitly with Haraoka's invariant form for Pochhammer systems, recover the Gauss case of the Beukers-Heckman interlacing criterion, and determine the definite parameter intervals for the Hecke and Temperley-Lieb specializations.
summary:
Katz-Long-Moody 构造与由 Artin 动作定义的自由群和编织群的半直积的表示相关联，非零参数与同一群的新表示相关联。在纯辫子组上，它对应于 Haraoka 的 KZ 型方程的乘法中间卷积。对于酉输入和单位圆上除 1 之外的卷积参数，该构造为商表示配备了规范的非简并不变埃尔米特形式。我们根据输入局部单数的本征角、其有序积的本征角和卷积参数给出了其签名的封闭公式。该公式说明了传递到商之前形式的内核以及谐振参数处的签名变化。它精确地确定归纳形式何时是确定的，回答了配套论文中提出的确定性问题。确定性意味着输出表示的统一性；当该表示不可约时，反之亦然。

该证明使用初等线性代数：行列式恒等式、显式块枢轴公式以及酉矩阵凯莱变换之和的惯性公式。作为应用，我们将 Pochhammer 系统的一阶构造与 Haraoka 的不变形式进行显式比较，恢复 Beukers-Heckman 交错准则的高斯情况，并确定 Hecke 和 Temperley-Lieb 特化的确定参数区间。

title: Perfect $(s,r)$-state transfer
abstract: Much work has been done in the last two decades on the topic of quantum state transfer in a quantum spin network. One can model such a system of interacting qubits using an undirected graph, and studying vertex-to-vertex dynamics. This setup has recently been relaxed to allow for dynamics between linear combinations of two vertex states, i.e.\ from $\mathbf u = \mathbf e_a + s \mathbf e_b$ to $\mathbf \mu=\mathbf e_{\alpha} + r \mathbf e_{\beta}$, where $r=s$ is either $-1$ (which corresponds to pair state transfer) or $+1$ (which corresponds to plus state transfer), or more recently $r=s$ is taken to be any real number (which corresponds to $s$-pair state transfer). Here, we broaden the investigation of $s$-pair state transfer to \textit{perfect $(s,r)$-state transfer}, which is perfect state transfer from $\mathbf u = \mathbf e_a + s \mathbf e_b$ to $\mathbf \mu=\mathbf e_{\alpha} + r \mathbf e_{\beta}$ (up to some dilation) where $r,s\in \mathbb C$. We identify infinite families of graphs with perfect $(s,r)$-state transfer and provide characterizations of cases when $|r|= |s|$ and when $|r|\neq |s|$, showing situations when the degree of entanglement between vertex states is preserved, and when it is not preserved. The latter is particularly important as it represents perfect state transfer from an entangled pair of qubits to another one where the degree of entanglement need not be the same\mdash in fact, it can be set up so as to ``boost'' (increase) entanglement. We provide an algorithm that finds the vector with two nonzero entries that maximizes the fidelity of transfer for a fixed time $t$ starting from a given $s$-pair state $\mathbf u$. Finally, we provide a sensitivity analysis, with respect to readout time errors, of perfect $(s,r)$-state transfer.
summary:
在过去的二十年里，关于量子自旋网络中的量子状态转移的主题已经做了很多工作。人们可以使用无向图对这样一种相互作用的量子位系统进行建模，并研究顶点到顶点的动力学。这个设置最近已经放宽，允许两个顶点状态的线性组合之间的动态，即从 $\mathbf u = \mathbf e_a + s \mathbf e_b$ 到 $\mathbf \mu=\mathbf e_{\alpha} + r \mathbf e_{\beta}$，其中 $r=s$ 是 $-1$ （对应于对状态转移）或 $+1$ （对应加上状态转移），或者最近 $r=s$ 被视为任何实数（对应于 $s$ 对状态转移）。在这里，我们将$s$对状态转移的研究范围扩大到\textit{完美$(s,r)$-状态转移}，这是从$\mathbf u = \mathbf e_a + s \mathbf e_b$到$\mathbf \mu=\mathbf e_{\alpha} + r \mathbf e_{\beta}$（达到一定程度的扩张）的完美状态转移，其中$r,s\in \mathbb C$。

我们识别具有完美 $(s,r)$ 状态转移的无限图族，并提供 $|r|= |s|$ 和 $|r|\neq |s|$ 时的情况特征，显示保留和不保留顶点状态之间的纠缠程度的情况。后者尤其重要，因为它代表了从一对纠缠量子位到另一对量子位的完美状态转移，其中纠缠程度不需要相同\mdash事实上，它可以被设置为“增强”（增加）纠缠。我们提供了一种算法，可以找到具有两个非零条目的向量，该向量可以最大化从给定的 $s$ 对状态 $\mathbf u$ 开始的固定时间 $t$ 内的传输保真度。最后，我们提供了关于完美 $(s,r)$ 状态转移的读出时间误差的敏感性分析。

title: A Quantum-Inspired Dequantization Method for Diagonally Weighted Matrix Functions: Application to Learning with Optimized Random Features
abstract: Quantum-inspired classical algorithms have dequantized several quantum machine learning routines by replacing quantum linear-algebra subroutines with classical counterparts. However, the sampler based on quantum singular value transformation (QSVT) for learning with optimized random features is not covered by existing dequantization frameworks, because the matrix to be inverted is not itself available through sampling access. In this work, we develop a classical algorithm to address this type of quantum-advantage candidate. Our method samples heavy indices, reduces the transformation to a small principal block, and outputs a sparse classical representation with operator-norm guarantees. Applying this method dequantizes the sampler for optimized random features, giving a classical sampler with prescribed accuracy and polynomially related runtime. These results show that the factorization underlying a quantum block encoding can itself provide sufficient classical structure even when sampling-and-query access to the composite matrix is unavailable.
summary: 受量子启发的经典算法通过用经典对应子例程替换量子线性代数子例程，对多个量子机器学习例程进行了反量化。然而，现有的反量化框架并未涵盖基于量子奇异值变换（QSVT）的用于学习优化随机特征的采样器，因为要反转的矩阵本身无法通过采样访问获得。在这项工作中，我们开发了一种经典算法来解决这种类型的量子优势候选者。我们的方法对重指数进行采样，将变换减少到一个小的主块，并输出具有算子范数保证的稀疏经典表示。应用此方法可以对采样器进行反量化，以获得优化的随机特征，从而提供具有规定精度和多项式相关运行时间的经典采样器。这些结果表明，即使在无法对复合矩阵进行采样和查询访问时，量子块编码的分解本身也可以提供足够的经典结构。

title: Tight Time-Space Lower Bounds for Collision Finding and Element Distinctness under Label Symmetry
abstract: How much memory is needed to retain the quantum speedup for collision finding? For a uniformly random function $f:[N]\to [N]$, the BHT algorithm finds a collision using $O(N^{1/3})$ queries and a quantumly accessible classical table containing $O(N^{1/3})$ input-output pairs, whereas a logarithmic-space Grover search uses $O(\sqrt N)$ queries. Determining the optimal query-space tradeoff between these extremes remains a major open problem. We resolve this equation within the class of label-symmetric algorithms, which treat the function $f$'s output labels as interchangeable. We prove that such algorithm that makes $T$ queries, uses $S$ qubits, and finds a collision in a uniformly random function $f:[M]\to [N]$ with constant probability satisfies $$T=\Omega(N^{1/3}) \qquad\text{and}\qquad T^2S=\Omega(N\log N).$$ For the setting where $M=N$, these bounds are matched by a space-efficient implementation of the BHT algorithm. As a consequence of our tradeoff, any label-symmetric algorithm for the search version of Element Distinctness on $f: [n] \to [n^2]$ must satisfy $$T=\Omega(n^{2/3}) \qquad\text{and}\qquad T^2S=\Omega(n^2\log n),$$ matching Ambainis's quantum walk. Thus, both tradeoffs are optimal within the class of label-symmetric algorithms. To prove these results, we develop a space-sensitive version of the compressed oracle technique. The compressed oracle records the information learned by the algorithm in an evolving superposition of databases. Using label symmetry and representation theory, we show that an algorithm using $S$ qubits can effectively retain information about only $O(S/\log N)$ collision-free database entries. Substituting this estimate into the compressed oracle technique yields the stated tradeoffs.
summary:
需要多少内存来保留碰撞发现的量子加速？对于均匀随机函数 $f:[N]\to [N]$，BHT 算法使用 $O(N^{1/3})$ 查询和包含 $O(N^{1/3})$ 输入输出对的量子可访问经典表来查找冲突，而对数空间 Grover 搜索使用 $O(\sqrt N)$ 查询。确定这些极端情况之间的最佳查询空间权衡仍然是一个主要的悬而未决的问题。我们在标签对称算法类中求解这个方程，该算法将函数 $f$ 的输出标签视为可互换的。我们证明，这种算法进行 $T$ 查询，使用 $S$ 量子位，并以恒定概率在均匀随机函数 $f:[M]\to [N]$ 中找到碰撞，满足 $$T=\Omega(N^{1/3}) \qquad\text{and}\qquad T^2S=\Omega(N\log N)。$$ 对于 $M=N$ 的设置，这些边界与BHT 算法的空间高效实现。作为我们权衡的结果，$f: [n] \to [n^2]$ 上元素独特性搜索版本的任何标签对称算法都必须满足 $$T=\Omega(n^{2/3}) \qquad\text{and}\qquad T^2S=\Omega(n^2\log n),$$ 匹配 Ambainis 的量子行走。

因此，这两种权衡在标签对称算法类别中都是最佳的。为了证明这些结果，我们开发了压缩预言技术的空间敏感版本。压缩的预言机将算法学到的信息记录在不断发展的数据库叠加中。使用标签对称性和表示理论，我们表明使用 $S$ 量子位的算法可以有效地保留仅 $O(S/\log N)$ 无碰撞数据库条目的信息。将此估计值代入压缩预言机技术会产生所述的权衡。

title: The Quantum Overlap Gap Property and Algorithmic Hardness for the Quantum Hypergraph Max-Cut Problem
abstract: In this work, we analyze the average-case hardness of approximation for the Quantum Hypergraph Max-Cut problem using the theoretical framework of the Quantum Overlap Gap Property (QOGP). We establish two main results. Our first result applies to a wide class of stable quantum algorithms, satisfying a Lipschitz property with respect to the quantum Wasserstein distance of order $2$. We show a weak hardness result, demonstrating that for any Lipschitz constant $L$, there is some $k$ such that $L$-stable algorithms cannot approximate the optimal solution to Quantum Hypergraph Max-Cut on $k$-uniform hypergraphs in the average case. Additionally, we establish a strong hardness result where $k$ is independent of $L$, but only for a more restricted class of local quantum algorithms defined using the quantum Wasserstein distance of order $\infty$. We apply these results to establish concrete depth lower bounds for popular quantum algorithms for preparing near-optimal states for this problem.
summary: 在这项工作中，我们使用量子重叠间隙性质（QOGP）的理论框架分析了量子超图最大割问题的近似平均硬度。我们得出两个主要结果。我们的第一个结果适用于多种稳定的量子算法，满足 $2$ 量级的量子 Wasserstein 距离的 Lipschitz 属性。我们展示了较弱的硬度结果，证明对于任何 Lipschitz 常数 $L$，存在一些 $k$，使得 $L$ 稳定算法无法在平均情况下逼近 $k$ 均匀超图上的量子超图最大割的最优解。此外，我们建立了一个强硬度结果，其中 $k$ 独立于 $L$，但仅适用于使用 $\infty$ 阶量子 Wasserstein 距离定义的更受限制的局部量子算法。我们应用这些结果来为流行的量子算法建立具体的深度下限，以便为这个问题准备接近最佳的状态。

title: Threshold Behavior of ZX and ZY Surface Codes Under Circuit-Level Biased and Crosstalk Noise
abstract: Studying the threshold behavior of surface codes under biased noise models is an active area of research. Previous work Tuckett et al. (2018), using an optimal tensor-network decoder, demonstrated that replacing $Z$-type stabilizers with $Y$-type stabilizers significantly improves the surface code threshold under code-capacity level dephasing noise. In this work, we construct and study a $ZY$ surface code by replacing the $X$-type stabilizers with $Y$-type stabilizers. We compare it with the standard $ZX$ surface code under circuit-level Pauli-$X$ biased noise, with and without an additional gate-based $XX$ crosstalk noise. We find that for the $ZX$ surface code, the $X$-memory threshold increases monotonically with bias while the $Z$-memory threshold decreases and saturates. For the $ZY$ surface code, the $Y$-memory threshold is nearly constant across all bias values. The $Z$-memory thresholds of the $ZX$ and $ZY$ codes are consistent within the uncertainty. Adding $XX$ crosstalk reduces the $Z$-memory threshold beyond the fitting uncertainty while leaving the $X$ memory threshold largely unaffected. The choice of CNOT ordering redistributes threshold performance between the two logical memories. Our work extends prior observations from code-capacity level noise to circuit-level noise. It also indicates the need for decoders capable of jointly reasoning over correlated syndrome information so that tailored stabilizer structures could be fully utilized for quantum error correction.
summary:
研究有偏差噪声模型下表面代码的阈值行为是一个活跃的研究领域。塔克特等人之前的工作。 (2018) 使用最优张量网络解码器证明，用 $Y$ 型稳定器替换 $Z$ 型稳定器可显着提高代码容量级别相移噪声下的表面代码阈值。在这项工作中，我们通过用 $Y$ 型稳定器替换 $X$ 型稳定器来构建和研究 $ZY$ 表面代码。我们将其与电路级 Pauli-$X$ 偏置噪声下的标准 $ZX$ 表面代码进行比较，有或没有基于门的额外 $XX$ 串扰噪声。我们发现，对于 $ZX$ 表面代码，$X$ 内存阈值随着偏差单调增加，而 $Z$ 内存阈值减少并饱和。对于 $ZY$ 表面代码，$Y$ 内存阈值在所有偏差值上几乎恒定。 $ZX$ 和 $ZY$ 代码的 $Z$ 内存阈值在不确定性范围内是一致的。添加 $XX$ 串扰可降低 $Z$ 内存阈值超出拟合不确定性，同时使 $X$ 内存阈值基本不受影响。

CNOT 排序的选择在两个逻辑存储器之间重新分配阈值性能。我们的工作将先前的观察结果从代码容量级噪声扩展到电路级噪声。它还表明需要能够对相关校正子信息进行联合推理的解码器，以便可以充分利用定制的稳定器结构进行量子纠错。

title: Probing the Error-Mitigation Threshold with Matrix Product States
abstract: Quantum error mitigation relies on accurate noise characterization, but mismatches between the actual and characterized noise can be amplified and drive a sharp threshold between successful and failed mitigation. In random circuits, this threshold maps onto a random-field Ising transition, but previous exact numerics were limited to small one-dimensional and all-to-all systems, leaving explicit two-dimensional architectures unresolved. We develop a fixed-bond-dimension matrix-product-state method for the replicated transfer dynamics that extends threshold calculations beyond exact propagation while retaining the finite-size signatures of the transition. At system sizes beyond previous exact studies, we recover the predicted absence of a threshold for quenched disorder in 1D, obtain a sharper annealed all-to-all critical point, and resolve architecture-dependent finite-depth thresholds in 2D square and heavy-hex circuits. These results establish replicated tensor-network dynamics as a practical tool for probing error-mitigation thresholds in large and higher-dimensional noisy circuits.
summary: 量子误差缓解依赖于准确的噪声表征，但实际噪声和特征噪声之间的不匹配可能会被放大，并在成功缓解和失败缓解之间形成一个尖锐的阈值。在随机电路中，该阈值映射到随机场伊辛跃迁，但以前的精确数值仅限于小型一维和全对所有系统，而无法解决显式的二维架构。我们开发了一种用于复制转移动力学的固定键维矩阵产物状态方法，该方法将阈值计算扩展到精确传播之外，同时保留转移的有限大小特征。在超出之前精确研究的系统尺寸上，我们恢复了一维中猝灭无序阈值的预测缺失，获得了更清晰的退火全临界点，并解决了二维方形和重六边形电路中依赖于架构的有限深度阈值。这些结果将复制张量网络动力学建立为探测大型和高维噪声电路中误差缓解阈值的实用工具。

title: Low-cost algorithm-to-execution framework for surface-code quantum computing
abstract: The execution of useful quantum algorithms on fault-tolerant processors requires more than a mapping from logical gates to encoded operations: the spatial organization, non-Clifford resource supply, and execution schedule must also be determined while keeping physical overhead within practical limits. Although the theoretical hierarchy from logical circuits to fault-tolerant operations is well established, these implementation choices are often specified and optimized separately. Here we develop a low-cost algorithm-to-execution framework for surface-code quantum computing. From hierarchical algorithm descriptions, it constructs dependency-preserving logical schedules and an executable workload capturing logical interactions, operation parallelism, and time-resolved non-Clifford demand, thereby linking logical computation to surface-code organization, resource-state preparation, and fault-tolerant execution in a traceable workflow. We apply the framework to twenty benchmark circuits across seven algorithm families and a hierarchically composed application-scale elliptic-curve discrete-logarithm workload. Physical costs vary substantially even for circuits with similar logical resource counts. Under our direct-rotation calibration, non-Clifford implementation selection reduces space-time volume by up to 241.5 times versus an all-synthesis baseline for the QAOA amplitude-amplification workload. Circuit-specific surface-code layouts reduce routed-latency estimates for all twenty benchmarks; thirteen also reduce space-time volume because communication savings outweigh added spatial overhead. These results show that low-cost fault-tolerant execution depends on computation scheduling and organization, not aggregate logical resource counts alone.
summary:
在容错处理器上执行有用的量子算法需要的不仅仅是从逻辑门到编码操作的映射：还必须确定空间组织、非 Clifford 资源供应和执行计划，同时将物理开销保持在实际限制内。尽管从逻辑电路到容错操作的理论层次结构已经很好地建立，但这些实现选择通常是单独指定和优化的。在这里，我们开发了一种用于表面代码量子计算的低成本算法到执行框架。根据分层算法描述，它构建了保留依赖关系的逻辑调度和可执行工作负载，捕获逻辑交互、操作并行性和时间解析的非 Clifford 需求，从而将逻辑计算与可跟踪工作流中的表面代码组织、资源状态准备和容错执行联系起来。我们将该框架应用于跨七个算法系列的二十个基准电路以及分层组成的应用程序规模椭圆曲线离散对数工作负载。

即使对于具有相似逻辑资源数量的电路，物理成本也有很大差异。在我们的直接旋转校准下，与 QAOA 幅度放大工作负载的全合成基线相比，非 Clifford 实现选择可将时空体积减少多达 241.5 倍。电路特定的表面代码布局减少了所有二十个基准的路由延迟估计； 13 还可以减少时空体积，因为节省的通信量超过了增加的空间开销。这些结果表明，低成本的容错执行取决于计算调度和组织，而不是单独聚合逻辑资源计数。

title: Sample-optimal learning of stabilizer states
abstract: It is well-known that learning a pure $n$-qubit stabilizer state $|\psi\rangle$ both requires, and can be accomplished with, access to a number of copies of $|\psi\rangle$ linear in $n$. However, the precise constant coefficient of this scaling does not appear to have been determined. Here we prove that $L_\delta(n)$, the smallest number of copies from which a quantum procedure can identify any stabilizer state with failure probability at most $0<\delta<1/8$, satisfies $n+\lceil\log_2(1/\delta)\rceil-3\leq L_\delta(n)\leq n+\left\lceil\log_2(1/\delta)\right\rceil+4$. We present a polynomial-time quantum learning algorithm that saturates this bound, achieving a constant factor improvement in sample-complexity over previously known approaches. As an immediate corollary, we obtain via the Choi-Jamiolkowski isomorphism an algorithm for learning an unknown $n$-qubit Clifford unitary from $2n+\left\lceil\log_2(1/\delta)\right\rceil+4$ queries, the $n$-dependence of which we show to be optimal. Our proof technique, which involves Fourier analysis on the abelian group $\mathbb{Z}_4^n \times \mathbb{F}_2^{n(n-1)/2}$, seems to be qualitatively different to previous approaches to stabilizer state learning, and may be of some independent interest; in particular, it admits natural generalisations to further problems in quantum learning theory.
summary:
众所周知，学习纯 $n$-qubit 稳定器状态 $|\psi\rangle$ 既需要访问 $n$ 中 $|\psi\rangle$ 线性的多个副本，也可以通过访问来完成。然而，这种缩放比例的精确常数系数似乎尚未确定。在这里，我们证明$L_\delta(n)$是量子过程可以识别任何稳定器状态的最小副本数，其失效概率最多为$0<\delta<1/8$，满足$n+\lceil\log_2(1/\delta)\rceil-3\leq L_\delta(n)\leq n+\left\lceil\log_2(1/\delta)\right\rceil+4$。我们提出了一种多项式时间量子学习算法，该算法使该界限饱和，与之前已知的方法相比，实现了样本复杂性的恒定因子改进。作为直接推论，我们通过 Choi-Jamiolkowski 同构获得了一种算法，用于从 $2n+\left\lceil\log_2(1/\delta)\right\rceil+4$ 查询中学习未知的 $n$-qubit Clifford酉，我们证明其 $n$-依赖性是最佳的。

我们的证明技术涉及阿贝尔群 $\mathbb{Z}_4^n \times \mathbb{F}_2^{n(n-1)/2}$ 的傅里叶分析，似乎与以前的稳定器状态学习方法有质的不同，并且可能具有一些独立的兴趣；特别是，它承认对量子学习理论中进一步问题的自然概括。

title: Full Inseparability and Genuine Multipartite Entanglement Coincide for Finite-Mode Gaussian States
abstract: For general mixed states, entanglement across every bipartition need not imply genuine multipartite entanglement (GME), because a biseparable decomposition may switch the separable cut from term to term. We prove that this convex ambiguity disappears for Gaussian states of finitely many bosonic modes. More generally, for any finite family of partitions, a Gaussian density operator in the trace-norm-closed convex class generated by states separable across those partitions is already separable across one fixed partition in the family. Only the target is Gaussian; a valid decomposition may be continuous and may contain arbitrary non-Gaussian states. Thus full inseparability and GME coincide, Gaussian k-separability and k-producibility reduce to fixed-partition tests, and party-wise tensor powers cannot activate GME from a biseparable Gaussian state. The proof combines a spectral selector with a holomorphic rigidity argument that converts one product vector in the square-root range of a Gaussian state into a block-local covariance certificate. The result shows that partition mixing, a generic mixed-state mechanism, adds no new exact finite-mode Gaussian states.
summary: 对于一般的混合态，跨越每个二分的纠缠不一定意味着真正的多分纠缠（GME），因为可分分解可能会在项之间切换可分切割。我们证明，对于有限多个玻色子模式的高斯态，这种凸模糊性消失。更一般地，对于任何有限族的分区，由跨这些分区可分离的状态生成的迹范数封闭凸类中的高斯密度算子已经可以跨族中的一个固定分区分离。只有目标是高斯的；有效的分解可以是连续的并且可以包含任意的非高斯状态。因此，完全不可分性和 GME 一致，高斯 k-可分离性和 k-可产生性简化为固定分区测试，并且派对张量幂无法从可分高斯状态激活 GME。该证明将谱选择器与全纯刚性参数相结合，将高斯状态平方根范围内的一个乘积向量转换为块局部协方差证书。结果表明，分区混合（一种通用的混合状态机制）没有添加新的精确有限模式高斯状态。

title: Bargmann Invariants Are Insufficient for Complete Local-Unitary Orbit Discrimination
abstract: Bargmann invariants constructed from a bipartite density operator and its two lifted marginals are polynomial invariants of local-unitary conjugation. We determine the precise information encoded in these invariants. Whenever one subsystem is a qubit, the ordinary marginal-word family determines the full spectrum of the partial transpose and hence decides whether the state has the positive-partial-transpose property. In $2\otimes2$ and $2\otimes3$ systems, this yields complete separability criteria. For the two-qubit system, a finite subfamily additionally separates local-unitary orbits, and a finite extension generates the polynomial invariant ring. These three tasks already diverge for qubit-qutrit states: we exhibit full-rank, locally maximally mixed states that agree on all ordinary marginal-word invariants yet have different operator-Schmidt ranks, together with a quartic correlation invariant that separates them. When both local dimensions are at least three, the analogous collapse on the locally maximally mixed sector produces isospectral pairs consisting of one separable state and one entangled state with negative partial transpose. The ordinary Bargmann algebra therefore coincides with the full local unitary invariant ring if and only if both subsystems are qubits. The missing data are geometric: they encode the placement of global eigenspaces relative to the tensor-product decomposition
summary:
由二分密度算子构造的巴格曼不变量及其两个提升边缘是局部酉共轭的多项式不变量。我们确定这些不变量中编码的精确信息。每当一个子系统是一个量子位时，普通的边缘词族就决定了部分转置的全谱，从而决定了状态是否具有正部分转置属性。在 $2\otimes2$ 和 $2\otimes3$ 系统中，这产生了完全的可分离性标准。对于双量子位系统，有限子族另外分离局部酉轨道，并且有限扩展生成多项式不变环。这三个任务对于 qubit-qutrit 状态已经有所不同：我们展示了全秩、局部最大混合状态，这些状态与所有普通边缘字不变量一致，但具有不同的算子施密特等级，以及将它们分开的四次相关不变量。当两个局部维度都至少为三时，局部最大混合扇区上的类似塌陷会产生由一种可分离态和一种具有负部分转置的纠缠态组成的等谱对。

因此，当且仅当两个子系统都是量子位时，普通巴格曼代数与完全局部酉不变环一致。缺失的数据是几何的：它们编码全局特征空间相对于张量积分解的位置

title: Virtual quantum neural networks
abstract: Quantum neural networks are a prominent model of quantum machine learning. Their training consists in the minimization of a given loss function over a parametrized family of quantum circuits, mathematically described by unitary operators, or, more generally, completely positive linear maps. In this work, we extend the notion of quantum neural network, using random sampling and classical data processing to enlarge the optimization space in a way that includes linear combinations of completely positive maps. Our extended model, called virtual quantum neural networks, leverages its enlarged optimization space to achieve increased expressivity and improved noise robustness. These benefits are illustrated in three representative tasks: quantum error mitigation, binary classification, and estimation of ground-state energies. Overall, virtual quantum neural networks offer a flexible learning paradigm that expands the space of achievable computations and strengthens the applications of near-term quantum hardware.
summary: 量子神经网络是量子机器学习的一个重要模型。他们的训练包括在参数化的量子电路系列上最小化给定的损失函数，由酉算子进行数学描述，或者更一般地说，完全正线性映射。在这项工作中，我们扩展了量子神经网络的概念，使用随机采样和经典数据处理以包括完全正映射的线性组合的方式扩大优化空间。我们的扩展模型称为虚拟量子神经网络，利用其扩大的优化空间来提高表现力并提高噪声鲁棒性。这些好处在三个代表性任务中得到了说明：量子误差缓解、二元分类和基态能量估计。总体而言，虚拟量子神经网络提供了一种灵活的学习范式，可以扩展可实现的计算空间并增强近期量子硬件的应用。

title: Quantum Random Access Memory Implementation Using Photon-Photon Interaction in Rydberg Atomic Ensemble
abstract: Quantum random access memory (qRAM) is crucial for overcoming data-loading bottlenecks in quantum machine learning; however, current physical implementations face severe scalability constraints. Traditional fanout designs demand exponential decoherence-prone gates, while bucket-brigade schemes require highly error-prone active switches. Motivated by these limitations, we propose a scalable qRAM architecture that fundamentally replaces active nodes with phase-encoded quantum walkers. Our methodology maps a discrete-time quantum walk onto a cavity quantum electrodynamics framework utilizing an electromagnetically induced transparency (EIT)-based Rydberg atomic ensemble. Inside hollow-core waveguides, strong Rydberg dipole-dipole interactions and a solenoidal magnetic field create a robust routing operator. This operator imparts precise, polarization-dependent phase shifts, steering circularly polarized probe pulses to target memory cells. Our results demonstrate that operating within a strong control field regime suppresses emergent spatial attenuation, ensuring cumulative transmission probabilities for highly scaled memory addresses. Ultimately, this parallelized architecture successfully optimizes spatial resources to static gates and temporal complexity to an optimal logarithmic scale of $\mathcal{O}(n\log(n+m))$ by requiring $\mathcal{O}(n+m)$ physical walkers, establishing a practical, fault-tolerant hardware pathway for advanced quantum computation implementations.
summary:
量子随机存取存储器（qRAM）对于克服量子机器学习中的数据加载瓶颈至关重要；然而，当前的物理实现面临着严重的可扩展性限制。传统的扇出设计需要容易出现指数退相干的门，而桶旅方案需要高度容易出错的有源开关。受这些限制的启发，我们提出了一种可扩展的 qRAM 架构，该架构从根本上用相位编码的量子行走器取代了有源节点。我们的方法利用基于电磁感应透明（EIT）的里德堡原子系综将离散时间量子行走映射到腔量子电动力学框架上。在空心波导内部，强大的里德伯偶极子-偶极子相互作用和螺线管磁场创建了一个强大的路由算子。该算子提供精确的、偏振相关的相移，将圆偏振探测脉冲引导至目标存储单元。我们的结果表明，在强控制场范围内运行可以抑制出现的空间衰减，确保高度缩放的内存地址的累积传输概率。

最终，这种并行架构通过需要 $\mathcal{O}(n+m)$ 物理步行器，成功地将空间资源优化为静态门，将时间复杂性优化为最佳对数尺度 $\mathcal{O}(n\log(n+m))$，为高级量子计算实现建立了实用的、容错的硬件路径。

title: Quantum-RAM Implementation Using Multiple Interacting Rydberg-Blockaded EIT Systems
abstract: We propose a novel theoretical architecture for implementing a quantum random access memory (qRAM) based on quantum random walks in a Rydberg blockaded atomic ensemble utilizing multilevel Electromagnetically Induced Transparency (EIT). Unlike previous approaches that rely on geometric phase gates in solid-state or trapped ion systems, our scheme harnesses the strong, coherent dipole dipole interactions between Rydberg atoms to achieve high-fidelity phase control of photonic qubits without the need for cryogenic temperatures. By generating conditional phase shifts through cross-phase modulation in multiple lambda-type EIT systems, we realize the controlled unitary operations requisite for an efficient qRAM. In the proposed architecture, Zeeman splitting is used to engineer a set of parallel lambda systems in a cavity, where pairs of magnetic sublevels of the ground state are coupled to highly excited Rydberg states via circularly polarized laser pulses. These Rydberg excited EIT systems serve as the elementary phase gates that form the nodes of a binary tree enabling quantum random walking. Address and data qubits are encoded into distinct probe fields and coherently mapped into the metastable atomic states, where their interactions within the EIT medium generate conditional phases required for state-selective routing. The system uses $n+m$ layers of cold alkali atoms to form an $n$-level binary tree of Rydberg nodes connected to $2^n$ cavity-trapped memory atoms, operated by $n+m$ laser pulses acting as quantum walkers and address units. Our scheme offers a scalable, reducing operational complexity to $\mathcal{O}(n)$ and highly coherent pathway toward photonic qRAM, exploiting collective Rydberg interactions to realize programmable, parallel entangling operations in an atomic ensemble.
summary:
我们提出了一种新颖的理论架构，用于利用多级电磁感应透明（EIT）在里德堡封锁原子系综中实现基于量子随机游走的量子随机存取存储器（qRAM）。与之前依赖于固态或俘获离子系统中的几何相门的方法不同，我们的方案利用里德伯原子之间强烈的相干偶极子相互作用来实现光子量子位的高保真相位控制，而无需低温。通过在多个 lambda 型 EIT 系统中通过交叉相位调制生成条件相移，我们实现了高效 qRAM 所需的受控统一运算。在所提出的架构中，塞曼分裂用于在腔中设计一组并行 lambda 系统，其中基态的磁性子能级对通过圆偏振激光脉冲耦合到高度激发的里德堡态。这些里德伯激发的 EIT 系统充当基本相位门，形成二叉树的节点，从而实现量子随机行走。

地址和数据量子位被编码到不同的探测字段中，并连贯地映射到亚稳态原子状态，其中它们在 EIT 介质内的相互作用生成状态选择性路由所需的条件阶段。该系统使用 $n+m$ 层冷碱原子形成 $n$ 级里德伯节点二叉树，连接到 $2^n$ 空腔捕获存储器原子，由充当量子步行器和地址单元的 $n+m$ 激光脉冲操作。我们的方案提供了一种可扩展的、将操作复杂性降低到 $\mathcal{O}(n)$ 的方法，以及通往光子 qRAM 的高度相干的路径，利用集体里德伯相互作用在原子系综中实现可编程、并行纠缠操作。

title: From Analytic Structure to Quantum Complexity: Walsh-Pauli Representations of Continuum Operators
abstract: How does continuum operator structure appear in a finite qubit register? We address this question for analytic functions of diagonal operators represented in a binary basis, focusing on the Jordan--Lee--Preskill (JLP) momentum operator, by developing an operator-level generating-function framework for their Walsh-Pauli spectra. The construction determines the spectrum analytically and reveals exact support and parity selection rules, together with a nontrivial intra-shell hierarchy induced by the binary encoding. This provides a systematic characterization of Walsh compressibility and its relation to Pauli locality. As a controlled application, we consider generalized uncertainty-principle (GUP) kinematics as a tunable nonlinear odd deformation of momentum, showing how higher-order momentum terms redistribute spectral weight into progressively higher Pauli-weight sectors
summary: 连续统算子结构如何出现在有限量子位寄存器中？我们针对以二元基础表示的对角算子的解析函数解决了这个问题，重点关注 Jordan-Lee-Preskill (JLP) 动量算子，通过为其 Walsh-Pauli 谱开发算子级生成函数框架。该结构通过分析确定频谱，并揭示精确的支持和奇偶校验选择规则，以及由二进制编码引起的重要的壳内层次结构。这提供了沃尔什压缩性及其与泡利局域性关系的系统表征。作为受控应用，我们将广义不确定性原理 (GUP) 运动学视为动量的可调非线性奇变形，展示高阶动量项如何将谱权重重新分配到逐渐更高的泡利权重扇区中

title: The Quantum Composition Paradox
abstract: Quantum theory does not generally permit the probability laws obtained from individual unitary steps by the Born rule to be sewn into a consistent genealogy; we classify the exceptions and show that faithful composition can hold from an initial boundary yet fail after an internal restart. For finite-dimensional, composition-closed unitary families, universal composition holds exactly for unitary monomials, the phase-dressed permutations whose Born kernels realize reversible deterministic state machines. Prescribed sequences evade this obstruction. We classify all pairs of qubit unitary steps, give a necessary-and-sufficient criterion for pairs of qutrit unitary steps, and prove that a boundary-stable unitary sequence on a $d$-dimensional Hilbert space contains at most $d$ fully mixing steps, with equality in every prime dimension. We also construct arbitrarily long genuinely mixing sequences that compose from their initial boundary but fail after an internal restart, and a qutrit-controlled two-qubit realization with active interference. We define a Born--Chapman--Kolmogorov current that vanishes exactly when coherent and stepwise-checked endpoint laws agree, together with an associated measure of how many bits the endpoint reveals about the intermediate checking schedule. This state-machine connection provides a foundation for a quantum theory of music, in which unitary operations are notes and temporal boundaries are cues. Musical-transition prediction is proved PromiseBQP-complete, and the stepwise patterns that preserve a genealogy specify rules for rhythm, whereas the exceptional failure of that genealogy from an internal cue is the quantum music paradox.
summary:
量子理论通常不允许将玻恩规则从各个单一步骤获得的概率定律缝合到一致的谱系中；我们对例外情况进行了分类，并表明忠实的组合可以从初始边界保持不变，但在内部重新启动后会失败。对于有限维、组合封闭酉族，全称组合完全适用于酉单项式，即其玻恩核实现可逆确定性状态机的相整理排列。规定的顺序可以避开这种障碍。我们对所有量子位酉步骤对进行分类，给出了 qutrit 酉步骤对的充要准则，并证明 $d$ 维希尔伯特空间上的边界稳定酉序列最多包含 $d$ 个完全混合步骤，并且在每个素数维度上都相等。我们还构建了任意长的真正混合序列，这些序列从其初始边界组成，但在内部重新启动后失败，以及具有主动干扰的 qutrit 控制的双量子位实现。

我们定义了一个玻恩-查普曼-柯尔莫哥洛夫电流，当相干和逐步检查的端点定律一致时，该电流精确消失，同时还定义了端点揭示中间检查时间表的位数的相关测量值。这种状态机连接为音乐的量子理论提供了基础，其中单一运算是音符，时间边界是线索。音乐转换预测被证明是 PromiseBQP 完备的，并且保留谱系的逐步模式指定了节奏规则，而该谱系从内部线索中异常失败就是量子音乐悖论。

title: Local decoders for fault-tolerant quantum computation and translation-invariant stabilizer codes
abstract: We construct the first fully spatially local fault-tolerant quantum computer based on topological codes in fewer than four spatial dimensions. Our construction is a two-dimensional architecture that uses only geometrically local quantum and classical operations, bounded-speed classical communication and computation, and a constant density of quantum and classical resources. The core component is a new time-translation-invariant cellular-automaton decoder for the surface code. This decoder preserves logical information for a time stretched-exponential in the code distance and operates continuously during state injection, stabilizer-state preparation, lattice surgery, and transversal readout. We also prove that every translation-invariant topological Pauli stabilizer code is locally decodable under phenomenological noise.
summary: 我们构建了第一台基于少于四个空间维度的拓扑编码的完全空间局部容错量子计算机。我们的构造是一个二维架构，仅使用几何局部量子和经典运算、有界速度的经典通信和计算，以及恒定密度的量子和经典资源。核心组件是用于表面代码的新的时间平移不变元胞自动机解码器。该解码器在代码距离中保留指数时间拉伸的逻辑信息，并在状态注入、稳定器状态准备、晶格手术和横向读出期间连续运行。我们还证明了每个平移不变的拓扑泡利稳定器代码在现象学噪声下都是局部可解码的。

title: Birth and Death of Entanglement in Hamiltonian-Driven Quantum Games under Decoherence
abstract: Quantum game theory investigates the influence of quantum resources on strategic decision-making. In this work, two-player quantum games based on the Transverse Field Ising Model(TFIM) are investigated under amplitude-damping decoherence. The TFIM Hamiltonian naturally produces a family of entangling gates, enabling a physically motivated implementation of quantum games. The effects of noise on Nash equilibria, players' payoffs, concurrence and coherence of the quantum states for different initial states and strategy pairs are analyzed. The results show that decoherence progressively suppresses quantum strategic advantages, with maximum damping driving all outcomes to identical classical payoffs. The concurrence and coherence analysis of the states generated in the quantum game reveal initial state and strategy dependent quantum correlation dynamics, including entanglement sudden birth and death.
summary: 量子博弈论研究量子资源对战略决策的影响。在这项工作中，基于横向场伊辛模型（TFIM）的两人量子博弈在振幅阻尼退相干下进行了研究。 TFIM 哈密顿量自然地产生一系列纠缠门，从而能够以物理动机实现量子游戏。分析了噪声对不同初始状态和策略对的纳什均衡、参与者收益、量子态并发性和相干性的影响。结果表明，退相干逐渐抑制量子战略优势，最大阻尼驱动所有结果达到相同的经典收益。对量子游戏中生成的状态的并发和相干分析揭示了初始状态和策略相关的量子相关动力学，包括纠缠的突然产生和死亡。

title: Quantum models of interaction Hamiltonian and their paradoxes
abstract: In quantum physics it is commonplace to model the interaction of remote systems with a many-body Hamiltonian. Taking such an action-at-a-distance description {\it à la lettre} leads to various paradoxes related to faster-than-light communication and apparent inconsistencies in local energy accounting. It also neglects residual effects, such as entanglement between the remote systems and the mediator that implements the interaction, or the decoherence that arises when the remote systems undergo local evolution. We study simple microscopic quantum models that respect the light cone by design and reproduce two-body Hamiltonians. For these models we quantitatively analyze the residual effects of the microscopic mediator on the remote systems, including dressing of stationary states, and decoherence in the presence of fast local control. We show how the models resolve the paradoxes.
summary: 在量子物理学中，用多体哈密顿量对远程系统的相互作用进行建模是很常见的。采用这种超距作用描述{\it à la lettertre}会导致与超光速通信相关的各种悖论以及当地能源核算中明显的不一致。它还忽略了残余效应，例如远程系统和实现交互的中介之间的纠缠，或者远程系统经历局部演化时出现的退相干。我们研究简单的微观量子模型，这些模型在设计上遵循光锥并重现二体哈密顿量。对于这些模型，我们定量分析了微观介体对远程系统的残余影响，包括稳态的修饰以及快速本地控制下的退相干。我们展示了模型如何解决悖论。

title: A Near-Quartic Separation Between Certificate Complexity and Quantum Query Complexity
abstract: We construct a total Boolean function $f$ for which $Q(f) = \widetilde{O}(\sqrt[4]{C(f)})$, where $Q(f)$ denotes the bounded-error quantum query complexity and $C(f)$ denotes the certificate complexity. This resolves a longstanding open question and is tight up to logarithmic factors.
summary: 我们构造一个总布尔函数$f$，其中$Q(f) = \widetilde{O}(\sqrt[4]{C(f)})$，其中$Q(f)$表示有界误差量子查询复杂度，$C(f)$表示证书复杂度。这解决了一个长期悬而未决的问题，并且受到对数因子的限制。

title: A Geometric Theory of Quantum Entanglement
abstract: Entanglement Distance (ED) was originally proposed as a geometric measure of entanglement derived from the Fubini-Study metric on the projective Hilbert space. Independently, the Meyer-Wallach and Scott measures quantify multipartite entanglement via linear entropy. In this work, we demonstrate that these two seemingly distinct frameworks are mathematically identical for pure states of arbitrary finite dimensions. We prove that ED arises naturally as the trace of the Fubini-Study metric tensor over the local subalgebra of observables. Crucially, this geometric unification yields a direct operational interpretation: the global entanglement of a pure state is exactly proportional to the total Quantum Fisher Information (QFI) available for local unitary estimation. This bridges abstract information geometry with quantum metrology, demonstrating that ED dynamically quantifies resourcefulness for distributed quantum sensing, identifying Heisenberg-limited sensitivity in regimes where standard variance-based witnesses fail.
summary: 纠缠距离 (ED) 最初被提出作为纠缠的几何度量，源自射影希尔伯特空间上的 Fubini-Study 度量。 Meyer-Wallach 和 Scott 度量通过线性熵独立地量化多部分纠缠。在这项工作中，我们证明了这两个看似不同的框架对于任意有限维度的纯态在数学上是相同的。我们证明 ED 是作为 Fubini-Study 度量张量在可观测量的局部子代数上的迹而自然产生的。至关重要的是，这种几何统一产生了直接的操作解释：纯态的全局纠缠与可用于局部酉估计的总量子费希尔信息（QFI）完全成正比。这将抽象信息几何与量子计量学联系起来，证明 ED 动态量化分布式量子传感的足智多谋，在基于标准方差的见证失败的情况下识别海森堡有限的灵敏度。

title: An exchange-assisted entangling gate between 87Rb and 171Yb Rydberg atoms
abstract: Neutral-atom tweezer arrays support scalable quantum information processing. Dual-species $^{87}\mathrm{Rb}$--$^{171}\mathrm{Yb}$ arrays combine long-lived ytterbium nuclear-spin data qubits with fast, species-selective rubidium ancilla control and readout. However, realizing interspecies gates without inducing destructive Stark mixing in divalent atoms remains an outstanding problem. Here, we identify an optically accessible $S{+}S\leftrightarrow P{+}P$ Förster resonance at zero electric field, providing strong dipole-dipole exchange at array pitch. Using a shaped optical pulse under finite control response, we demonstrate a $0.36\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ exchange-assisted controlled-$Z$ gate with an intrinsic fidelity of $99.91\%$, remaining above $99.85\%$ under bounded perturbations. We also identify an auxiliary repulsive van der Waals channel, providing a comprehensive toolbox for hybrid quantum processors.
summary: 中性原子镊子阵列支持可扩展的量子信息处理。双物种 $^{87}\mathrm{Rb}$--$^{171}\mathrm{Yb}$ 阵列将长寿命镱核自旋数据量子位与快速、物种选择性铷辅助控制和读出相结合。然而，在不引起二价原子破坏性斯塔克混合的情况下实现种间门仍然是一个突出的问题。在这里，我们确定了零电场下光学可访问的 $S{+}S\leftrightarrow P{+}P$ Förster 共振，在阵列节距下提供强的偶极子-偶极子交换。使用有限控制响应下的整形光脉冲，我们展示了 $0.36\,\mu\mathrm{s}$ 交换辅助控制 $Z$ 门，其内在保真度为 $99.91\%$，在有界扰动下保持在 $99.85\%$ 以上。我们还确定了辅助排斥范德华通道，为混合量子处理器提供了全面的工具箱。

title: Learning structural balance of graphs from quantum spectral features
abstract: We develop a quantum approach to spectral feature extraction from the density of states (DOS) of a problem-dependent Hamiltonian, and apply it to machine learning on signed graphs. We propose to embed a signed graph as an Ising model instance with positive and negative interactions, and use the standardized moments of the Ising DOS as features for learning. We show that these moments count signed closed walks, are switching-invariant, and are size-free by construction. As a benchmark, we target learning the frustration index, an NP-hard measure of structural balance that can be labeled exactly at moderate size. At zero field, the models can be sampled classically, allowing the quantum extraction procedure to be certified against exact ground truth. We propose DOS-QPE, a phase estimation on a purified maximally mixed probe, which samples the spectral density with orders of magnitude fewer shots than Hadamard test-based trace sampling and feeds the resulting features directly into classically trained models. On $1.4\times10^5$ labeled graphs the exact DOS determines the frustration index, and five moments recover it with a mean error of 0.4, well below one sign flip. Beyond zero field, the underlying trace-estimation problem is DQC1-complete, providing access to spectral features for which no efficient classical sampling method is known. Our work opens routes towards quantum applications in social network balance analysis, spin-glass studies, correlation clustering, and protein-interaction networks.
summary:
我们开发了一种从问题相关哈密顿量的状态密度（DOS）中提取光谱特征的量子方法，并将其应用于带符号图的机器学习中。我们建议嵌入一个带符号图作为具有正向和负向交互的 Ising 模型实例，并使用 Ising DOS 的标准化矩作为学习特征。我们证明这些矩计算有符号闭合行走，是切换不变的，并且通过构造是无大小的。作为基准，我们的目标是学习挫败指数，这是一种结构平衡的 NP 难度量，可以精确地标记为适中的大小。在零场下，可以对模型进行经典采样，从而可以根据准确的地面事实来验证量子提取过程。我们提出了 DOS-QPE，这是一种对纯化的最大混合探针的相位估计，它以比基于 Hadamard 测试的迹线采样少几个数量级的次数对谱密度进行采样，并将所得特征直接输入到经典训练的模型中。在 $1.4\times10^5$ 标记的图表上，确切的 DOS 决定了挫败指数，并且五个时刻以 0.4 的平均误差恢复它，远低于一个符号翻转。

在零场之外，潜在的迹线估计问题是 DQC1 完整的，提供了对尚无有效的经典采样方法的光谱特征的访问。我们的工作为社交网络平衡分析、自旋玻璃研究、相关聚类和蛋白质相互作用网络中的量子应用开辟了道路。

title: Quantum transport along a tight-binding chain connected to Markovian reservoirs
abstract: We consider quantum transport of non-interacting particles in a tight-binding chain coupled to Markovian reservoirs at its boundaries and subject to uniform on-site dephasing. Using the masterequation approach, we derived the exact analytic solution for the mean current along the chain. This analytic solution is obtained in the framework of single-particle quantum mechanics and, thus, equally applies for transport of non-interacting bosons and fermions. In the absence of phase damping, the results are extended to the complete many-body solution for bosonic problem in the form of anti-normally ordered characteristic function. This function allows us to calculate the distribution function for the current at each bond in the chain as well as the inter-bond current correlation functions.
summary: 我们考虑紧束缚链中非相互作用粒子的量子传输，该束缚链在其边界处耦合到马尔可夫储库，并受到均匀的现场相移。使用主方程方法，我们得出了沿链的平均电流的精确解析解。该解析解是在单粒子量子力学的框架中获得的，因此同样适用于非相互作用玻色子和费米子的输运。在没有相位阻尼的情况下，结果以反正序特征函数的形式扩展到玻色子问题的完整多体解。该函数允许我们计算链中每个键的电流分布函数以及键间电流相关函数。

title: Strong Converse for Quantum Capacity via a Fully Quantum Blowing-Up Lemma
abstract: We prove an exponential strong converse for quantum communication through every finite-dimensional memoryless channel: at any fixed rate above the quantum capacity, the entanglement-transmission fidelity of every code decays exponentially with the number of channel uses. The proof has two main ingredients. First, a fully quantum blowing-up lemma converts a low-fidelity code into a high-fidelity code, with a loss in the number of transmitted qubits controlled by the projective tensor norm of the orthogonal projection on the image of the Stinespring dilation of the channel across the receiver--environment bipartition. Second, a low-degree polynomial construction approximates the tensor power of this projector with exponential accuracy while controlling its projective norm, providing the approximation needed for the blowing-up argument.
summary: 我们证明了通过每个有限维无记忆信道的量子通信的指数强逆：在高于量子容量的任何固定速率下，每个代码的纠缠传输保真度随着信道使用的数量呈指数衰减。证明有两个主要成分。首先，完全量子爆炸引理将低保真度代码转换为高保真度代码，传输量子比特数量的损失由接收器-环境二分上通道的 Stinespring 膨胀图像上的正交投影的投影张量范数控制。其次，低次多项式构造以指数精度近似该投影仪的张量幂，同时控制其投影范数，从而提供爆炸论证所需的近似值。

title: Absolutely Maximally Entangled States of $2q$ Parties in Every Odd Prime-Power Dimension $q$
abstract: Absolutely maximally entangled (AME) states represent an extreme form of multipartite entanglement: every reduced system containing at most half of the parties is maximally mixed. These states provide perfect tensors and optimal quantum error-correcting codes, yet their existence is known only in restricted parameter regimes. For every odd prime power $q=p^e\ge3$, we construct a stabilizer $\mathrm{AME}(2q,q)$ state whose normalized one-party projection yields a stabilizer $\mathrm{AME}(2q-1,q)$ state. A closed-form $q\times q$ bordered-circulant matrix $A_q$ over $\mathbb{F}_{q^2}$ generates a Hermitian self-dual maximum distance separable (MDS) code $[2q,q,q+1]_{q^2}$, which lies outside the extended Reed-Solomon classes. In suitable bases, the amplitude tensors define normalized $q$-unitary complex Hadamard matrices of order $q^q$ with $p$th-root phases. Additional constructions yield $\mathrm{AME}(q+3,q)$ states and families at intermediate particle numbers through explicit rescalings of selected submatrices. We also provide nine explicit parent matrices and the corresponding one-party projections.
summary: 绝对最大纠缠（AME）状态代表了多方纠缠的一种极端形式：每个包含最多一半参与方的简化系统都是最大混合的。这些状态提供了完美的张量和最佳的量子纠错码，但它们的存在仅在受限的参数范围内已知。对于每个奇素数幂 $q=p^e\ge3$，我们构建一个稳定器 $\mathrm{AME}(2q,q)$ 状态，其归一化单方投影产生一个稳定器 $\mathrm{AME}(2q-1,q)$ 状态。 $\mathbb{F}_{q^2}$ 上的封闭形式 $q\times q$ 有界循环矩阵 $A_q$ 生成 Hermitian 自对偶最大距离可分离 (MDS) 代码 $[2q,q,q+1]_{q^2}$，该代码位于扩展 Reed-Solomon 类之外。在合适的基中，幅度张量定义了 $q^q$ 阶、第 $p$ 根相位的归一化 $q$-酉复哈达玛矩阵。通过对选定子矩阵的显式重新缩放，附加构造会产生中间粒子数处的 $\mathrm{AME}(q+3,q)$ 状态和族。我们还提供了九个显式父矩阵和相应的一方投影。

title: Oracle Separations in the Fourier Hierarchy
abstract: The Fourier hierarchy $\mathrm{FH}_0\subseteq\mathrm{FH}_1\subseteq\mathrm{FH}_2\subseteq\cdots$, introduced by Shi (TCS 2005), measures a quantum computation by the number of Hadamard layers it uses. Between two layers the circuit may permute basis states and attach phases, but it may not create superposition; the layers are its only source of interference. The first level is exactly $\mathrm{BPP}$, while the second already solves Simon's problem and, through phase estimation, factors integers. Shi conjectured that every additional layer strictly increases computational power, and asked, as a first step, for oracle separations between consecutive levels. To our knowledge, the question was open at every level $k\ge2$. We prove that for every constant $k\ge2$ there is an oracle relative to which $\mathrm{FH}_k\subsetneq\mathrm{FH}_{k+1}$. The separating problem is built from Forrelation (Aaronson and Ambainis, STOC 2015): the level above solves it with a constant number of queries, whereas at level $k$ it stays hard even for circuits making exponentially many queries. This holds for both of the usual ways of giving a circuit access to an oracle, the phase oracle and the standard oracle, which writes its answer into a register. The two are not interchangeable: relative to an oracle, the standard oracle is strictly more powerful at the same number of layers. We also separate the union of all the levels from $\mathrm{BQP}$ relative to an oracle. The lower bounds rest on a structural property of the hierarchy: the number of Hadamard layers limits how adaptively a circuit can query its oracle. With a phase oracle, a circuit with $k$ layers is reproduced exactly by an algorithm making only $k-1$ rounds of parallel queries, which brings known lower bounds for such algorithms to bear. The standard oracle lets a circuit branch on earlier answers, and that case needs a separate argument.
summary:
Shi (TCS 2005) 引入的傅里叶层次结构 $\mathrm{FH}_0\subseteq\mathrm{FH}_1\subseteq\mathrm{FH}_2\subseteq\cdots$ 通过其使用的 Hadamard 层的数量来衡量量子计算。在两层之间，电路可以排列基本状态并附加相，但它可能不会产生叠加；这些层是其唯一的干扰源。第一个级别正是 $\mathrm{BPP}$，而第二个级别已经解决了西蒙的问题，并通过相位估计对整数进行因子分解。史推测，每增加一层都会严格增加计算能力，并要求第一步在连续层之间进行预言机分离。据我们所知，这个问题在每个级别 $k\ge2$ 上都是开放的。我们证明，对于每个常数 $k\ge2$ 都有一个相对于 $\mathrm{FH}_k\subsetneq\mathrm{FH}_{k+1}$ 的预言。分离问题是从 Forrelation 构建的（Aaronson 和 Ambainis，STOC 2015）：上面的级别通过恒定数量的查询来解决它，而在 $k$ 级别，即使对于进行指数级数量的查询的电路来说，它仍然很困难。

这适用于电路访问预言机的两种常用方法：相位预言机和标准预言机，后者将其答案写入寄存器。两者不可互换：相对于预言机，标准预言机在相同层数下更强大。我们还将所有级别的并集与相对于预言机的 $\mathrm{BQP}$ 分开。下限取决于层次结构的结构属性：Hadamard 层的数量限制了电路查询其预言机的自适应程度。使用相位预言机，具有 $k$ 层的电路可以通过仅进行 $k-1$ 轮并行查询的算法精确再现，这为此类算法带来了已知的下限。标准的预言机让电路根据早期的答案进行分支，这种情况需要一个单独的参数。

title: The cost of simulating classically tractable quantum circuits and dynamics
abstract: Determining whether a quantum evolution can be efficiently simulated classically is central to understanding the boundary between classical and quantum computation. However, polynomial-time simulability is an asymptotic statement, and does not by itself determine whether the (quantum-inspired) classical simulation is actually practical. Indeed, different polynomial scalings can lead to vastly different computational costs, particularly when expensive preprocessing or quantum data acquisition is required. In this work, we ask whether classically simulable quantum dynamics are in practice more resource-efficient to simulate classically than to execute directly on quantum hardware. We analyze this question using three resource metrics, quantum sample, quantum time, and classical time complexity, for several widely studied classically simulable circuit families. Using representative hardware-level estimates, we identify regimes in which quantum simulation can be faster despite the existence of a polynomial-time classical algorithm, as well as regimes in which classical simulation remains more efficient. At the same time, the large quantum sampling cost needed to characterize unknown input states can make this polynomial-time classical simulation prohibitively expensive with current cloud-based hardware access prices. Ultimately, our work indicates that guarantees of classical simulability with polynomial resources alone are insufficient to determine the preferred implementation.
summary:
确定量子演化是否可以有效地进行经典模拟对于理解经典计算和量子计算之间的边界至关重要。然而，多项式时间可模拟性是一种渐近陈述，其本身并不能确定（受量子启发的）经典模拟是否实际上实用。事实上，不同的多项式缩放可能会导致截然不同的计算成本，特别是当需要昂贵的预处理或量子数据采集时。在这项工作中，我们询问经典可模拟的量子动力学实际上是否比直接在量子硬件上执行更节省资源。我们使用三个资源指标（量子样本、量子时间和经典时间复杂度）针对几个广泛研究的经典可模拟电路系列来分析这个问题。使用代表性的硬件级估计，我们确定了尽管存在多项式时间经典算法，但量子模拟可以更快的机制，以及经典模拟仍然更高效的机制。

与此同时，表征未知输入状态所需的大量量子采样成本可能会使这种多项式时间经典模拟在当前基于云的硬件访问价格下过于昂贵。最终，我们的工作表明，仅用多项式资源保证经典可仿真性不足以确定首选实现。

title: EFI Pairs Without One-Way Puzzles: Oracle Separations from Communication Complexity
